hindsight_bias.name: Hindsight Bias
hindsight_bias.subtitle: I knew it all along!
hindsight_bias.description: The tendency to believe, after learning an outcome, that one would have foreseen it.
examples: Saying 'I knew that stock would fall' even though you didn't predict it.
After an election, thinking 'Of course they would win.'
overcome: Consciously recall the uncertainty at the time of decision.
Keep a decision journal to record predictions before outcomes.

status_quo_bias.name: Status Quo Bias
status_quo_bias.subtitle: Change is unnecessary risk
status_quo_bias.description: The preference to keep things the same, even when changing would be better.
examples: Hesitating to switch jobs even when better opportunities arise.
Maintaining unsatisfying relationships out of fear of change.
overcome: Objectively evaluate the hidden costs of the current state.
Start with small changes to build tolerance for change.

sunk_cost_fallacy.name: Sunk Cost Fallacy
sunk_cost_fallacy.subtitle: We've come too far to quit
sunk_cost_fallacy.description: The tendency to continue an endeavor because of previously invested resources.
examples: Watching a boring movie to the end because 'I paid for it.'
Continuing a failing project because 'we've invested so much.'
overcome: Decide from a 'from now on' perspective. Forget past investments.
Ask yourself if you would make the same choice if starting fresh.
